note: v480: Unlink works properly now. Unlinking a match you'd made by hand looked like it did nothing — the two items were immediately re-paired automatically, which was most obvious on paychecks and bills recorded from a bank line. Both sides now stay unlinked until you match them again yourself. An unmatched paycheck also has a Remove button, so one recorded on the wrong payday can be undone without a trip to the Budget tab.
